description: Na₂CoP₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-3.01 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.86 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two CoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.61 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.86 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. All Co-O bond lengths are 1.98 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Co-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.65 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom.
